# Ordinance No. 17, Series of 2003

**Municipal Solid Waste Management Board Creation Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance establishes the Municipal Solid Waste Management Board in Pitogo, Quezon. It defines the board's composition, functions, and duties related to solid waste management planning and implementation within the municipality. The ordinance aims to improve waste segregation and management practices across all sectors of the community.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1** - Title: This ordinance shall be known as Municipal Solid Waste Management Board in the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon.
2.  **Section 2** - This ordinance shall apply to all residential houses, commercial establishments such as hotels, restaurants, public market, groceries, institution like health center, schools, churches, public and private offices, industrial establishment and agricultural areas.
3.  **Section 3** - Composition: The Municipal Solid Waste Management Board shall be composed of the following:
    1.  Municipal Mayor as honorary chairman
    2.  [[Sangguniang Bayan]] - Committee on Environment or Committee on Health
    3.  ABC - President
    4.  SK Chairman
    5.  Municipal Health Officer
    6.  Municipal Agriculturist Officer
    7.  Department of Education
    8.  Representative from the NGO (environmentalist organization)
    9.  Representative from Recycling Industry
    10. Representative from Manufacturing of Packaging Industry
    11. Representative from Religious sector
    12. Municipal Engineer
    13. Philippine National Police
4.  **Section 4** - Function & Duties: The council shall have the following function:
    1.  To make municipal solid waste management plan and strategy to segregate the waste and implement to the barangay. To make consultation for creating the Solid Waste Management Plan in every sector of the community.
    2.  To make a proposal for viable and effective implementation of Solid Waste Management Plan in every barangay.
    3.  To make a proposal for generating fund or revenue generation for the possible implementation of SWMP.
    4.  The Council Members shall have a regular meeting and coordination for implementation of SWMP in every barangay.
    5.  The Council Members shall review the SWMP for every two years or if it is needed for the implementation of SWMP.
5.  **Section 5** - Any ordinance or part thereof which in inconsistent with the provision of this ordinance is hereby repealed.
6.  **Section 6** - This ordinance shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
